Some of the friendliest staff! I love my trips to the pet store as they are always such a wonderful stop on my errand runs.

Besides getting to stock up on all my kitties favourite treats, toys, food, and other supplies, it's clear the staff love animals and are always so welcoming and happy to help customers 😊

I love that they have a good section for cats, with all the big brands like Hill's Science Diet and Royal Cabin but also brands like Tiki Cat and Open Farm. There are lots of cat treats, Churu and Greenies of course lol but also different options of freeze dried chicken, salmon, beef, etc. They also sell supplements and little pouches of pumpkin puree which helps with digestion issues!

It may look like a small location but it has a lot of stock options! It's my go-to pet store in Old Town and I know my kitties are always getting the best stuff here 😊🫶🏻
Large pet value with lots of goodies
Superhelpful staff and a good collection of cat food and toys

This might seem like a run-of-the-mill Pet Valu, but it was my go-to pet store to procure any essentials for my cat, Pancake. It carries her litter, her food, her favourite treats, and a rotating assortment of toys.

“Only the best for my cat,” I say, when I reach for the cat treats that are slightly more expensive than her regular treats.

“She won’t know,” I say, when I return them for the cat treats she likes that are on sale instead.

“But what if she wants both?” I say, picking up both bags.

One thing about Pancake is that she doesn’t need a whole lot. It makes me want to give her the whole world.

Pancake’s favourite toy—a little brown mouse that squeaks—was purchased here. She absolutely loves this mouse. She’s torn out the eyes and one ear, and I would like to get her a new one, but I’ve never seen it for sale again—every time I look, it’s mostly wand toys and laser pointers. When Pancake sees this mouse, she hunts her butt off. She’ll pounce onto the mouse and gnaw at it, slobbering all over it, rolling onto her back…it’s a whole deal. If you look past the violent nature of life, of which we are all a part of—that hidden animalistic and primal tendencies residing in even the most decent of humans—it’s really adorable.

I did get Pancake a fancy bed from an online store (not Pet Valu, sorry Pet Valu), but even though she has her own place that’s all her own (I never use her bed, I’m actually too big) she still nestles next to me when she knows it’s time to sleep at night. I don’t know if she just likes the warmth or if she is trying to protect me from predators (which she is great at, by the way), but I’d like to think it’s because she loves me. I love my cat, Pancake. She might be the only girl I’ve loved that’s ever truly loved me back.

(40/52) @0117stefan
